title: Ograničavanje pristupa API-ju i nadogradnja
summary: Zatvaranje kapija API servera (anonimni pristup, Node,RBAC, NodeRestriction, izlaganje mreži, kubeconfig i CSR) i nadogradnja klastera zbog ranjivosti uz version skew pravila.
summary_en: Closing the API server's gates (anonymous access, Node,RBAC, NodeRestriction, network exposure, kubeconfig and CSRs) and upgrading the cluster to fix vulnerabilities while respecting version skew rules.
